title: How big is a 1 carat round?

hook.text: How big is a 1 carat round?

post.youtube_title: How big is a 1 carat round?
post.caption:
A 1 carat round measures about 6.5 millimeters across. A 2 carat round covers 49% of the width of a size 6 finger.

Round diamond size chart: https://www.heygema.com/en/gem-size/round-diamond-size-chart?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=shorts&utm_campaign=gem_size_shorts

Estimates for a well-cut stone.
